tools.name: get_citation

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_face_types, get_face_type, get_citation, get_embed_snippet · Public sink: list_face_types, get_face_type, get_embed_snippet.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_face_types, get_face_type, get_citation, get_embed_snippet · Public sink: list_face_types, get_face_type, get_embed_snippet

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
